ansi_params.h, stdarg.h, stddef.h, size_t.h and string.h: https://github.com/pret/pokeheartgold commit 6cedc4f57c9ce18821adbfff25c6aefbd0dc1176. stdio.h supplies only standard printf declarations and prerequisite types needed by Nitro headers; it provides no code or stubs. These headers are pinned in the SDK header manifest. Accepted functions still require complete recompilation and original-byte equality.
